answer: Every ballot stands on cut basalt. Each identity carves one terrace into the basalt roll — one vote seat per key — escrowing 30 POA. Each epoch the beacon flares a fresh nonce; the terrace owner must echo it signed in 60 seconds — one hand, one key. Lottery wardens replay one terrace in four each epoch, re-checking echoes and bonds. A missed, stale, or shared echo voids the seat — 30 POA slashed to the wardens, the key benches two epochs. N fakes × 30 POA = 30N POA slashed. Limit: honest keys lock the same 30.
